title: [task] Epic 0 — App shell, providers, NativeWind, lint/typecheck
body:
## Goal
Standalone runnable shell per `docs/PROJECT_STRUCTURE.md` + `docs/AGENT_RULES.md`.

## Work
- [ ] Wire root `app/_layout.tsx` providers: SafeArea, TanStack Query, Auth gate
- [ ] Verify NativeWind v4 + tailwind config builds on web + Expo Go
- [ ] Add `.env.example` (`EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`)

title: [task] Epic 0 — Supabase project, migrations, RLS, Storage buckets
body:
## Goal
Backend foundation per ERD in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §3.

## Work
- [ ] Create Supabase project, link with `supabase link`
- [ ] Migration `users`, `avatars`, `wardrobe_items`, `outfits`, `subscriptions` tables
- [ ] Enable RLS: users can only read/write own `user_id = auth.uid()` rows
- [ ] Storage buckets: `avatars` (public read), `wardrobe` (private), `outfits` (private)
- [ ] Seed `types/database.ts` from generated types

## Done
- [ ] Migration applies cleanly on fresh project
- [ ] RLS verified with two test users

Docs: `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §3.

title: [task] Epic 3 — Vision auto-tagging edge function (Gemini Flash free tier)
body:
## Goal
Auto-fill category, colors, formality, season.

## Work
- [ ] `supabase/functions/tag-item`: image -> Gemini Flash -> strict JSON `{category, colors, formality, season}`
- [ ] Secrets only in edge function, never in client (`docs/AGENT_RULES.md` §2)
- [ ] Client shows suggested tags, user can override before save

## Done

- [ ] Invalid JSON safely rejected + logged

Docs: `docs/PRD.md` §3.2, `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` §4 pipeline 2.

title: [task] Epic 5 — Outfit picker edge function (weather + event + mood -> item_ids)
body:
## Goal
LLM selects best `wardrobe_items` combo; enforces tier daily limits.

## Work
- [ ] `supabase/functions/generate-outfit`: inputs `{weather, events, mood, tier}` -> `{item_ids[3-5], reasoning}`
- [ ] Free: 1/day, Plus: 5/day, Pro: unlimited (check `users.tier` + `outfits.created_at`)
- [ ] Return 429 with upgrade hint when capped

## Done
